_readme: Translate the VALUES of en.json only; never change a key. Keep every {placeholder}, HTML tag and attribute exactly as written (translate only the text between tags). Never translate: the brand "The Cute Devil" / "the cute devil", product names, "Grand Minds Technology", "WhatsApp", "LinkedIn", the phone number, order references (TCD-…) and the text inside [SQUARE BRACKETS] (owner placeholders). Voice: charming, intriguing, a little mysterious; short sentences. Do not use words meaning trouble, bad, sin or naughty. Headlines, buttons, labels and badges are lowercase in English on purpose: keep them lowercase where your script has case. Plurals: keys ending in .one / .other are plural forms; if your language needs more forms add sibling keys with the same stem ending in .zero, .two, .few or .many (CLDR categories), each containing {n}.
brand.founderName: The founder's full legal name, used as {name} in other strings. Arabic (ar): write exactly "محمد خضر محمد عبدالماجد". EVERY other language: keep it in Latin letters exactly as written, "Mohamed Khedr Mohamed Abdelmaged" (no transliteration, no shortening).
footer.personal: Shown small under the tagline in the footer. {name} is the founder's full name (key brand.founderName): keep the placeholder. Keep "The Cute Devil" untranslated.
story.personal.eyebrow: Small label above story.personal.line. Lowercase, max about 22 characters.
story.personal.line: Clear statement on the story page. {name} is the founder's full name (key brand.founderName): keep the placeholder. Keep "The Cute Devil" untranslated.
home.founder.name: Only the {name} placeholder (the founder's full name, key brand.founderName). Copy it unchanged.
brand.tagline: The brand tagline. Two short sentences. Shown large in the footer (about 12 characters per line) and in the menu.
shell.home: Screen-reader label of the logo link. Keep "The Cute Devil" untranslated.
nav.shop: Main navigation, one word, lowercase. Also shown very large in the mobile menu: max about 9 characters.
nav.story: Main navigation, one word, lowercase. Max about 9 characters.
nav.contact: Main navigation, one word, lowercase. Max about 9 characters.
nav.shopHint: Small hint beside the big menu word on phones. Max about 20 characters.
nav.storyHint: Small hint beside the big menu word on phones. Max about 20 characters.
nav.contactHint: Small hint beside the big menu word on phones. Max about 20 characters.
theme.cream: Name of a colour theme (screen-reader label and tooltip of a colour dot).
theme.pick: Label beside the colour dots in the mobile menu. Lowercase, max about 20 characters.
lang.current: Screen-reader label of the language button. {name} is the language name in its own script.
lang.pick: Label beside the language select in the mobile menu. Lowercase, max about 20 characters.
bag.count.one: Screen-reader text. Plural form for one. {n} is the number.
bag.count.other: Screen-reader text. General plural form. {n} is the number.
footer.shade: Footer column title above the colour theme dots ("shade" = colour tone). One word, lowercase.
footer.talk: Footer column title above the contact links. Lowercase, max about 14 characters.
footer.whatsappLabel: Screen-reader label. {number} is the phone number.
footer.credit: Ownership credit. {company} becomes the linked name "Grand Minds Technology": keep the placeholder, do not translate the name.
footer.madein: Follows the credit line after a dot separator.
footer.link.shipping: Footer link. Short: max about 22 characters.
cursor.view: One short word shown inside the round mouse cursor over a product. Max 6 characters, lowercase.
cursor.drag: One short word shown inside the round mouse cursor. Max 6 characters, lowercase.
niche.wear: Product category: clothing. One short word, lowercase. Used as a filter chip, a label on cards, a giant headline word and inside other sentences ({niche}). Max about 8 characters.
niche.scent: Product category: perfumes. One short word, lowercase. Max about 8 characters.
niche.tech: Product category: gadgets. One short word, lowercase. Max about 8 characters.
common.openShop: Main button. Lowercase, max about 18 characters.
common.sample: Badge beside every price: the price is only an example. One word, max about 10 characters.
common.soon: Badge on a product card. Lowercase, max about 14 characters.
common.sold: Badge on a product card and a disabled button. Lowercase, max about 14 characters.
common.honest: Short honesty line under totals and buttons.
common.outside: Small tag: the visible side of a thing. One word, lowercase.
common.inside: Small tag: the hidden side of a thing. One word, lowercase.
common.founderTitle: Headline. The <span> part is shown in the accent colour: keep the tags around the second sentence.
common.artFallback: Screen-reader description of a product drawing. Keep the brand name.
cart.step.bag: Step name in the checkout progress bar. One word, lowercase, max about 9 characters.
cart.step.details: Step name in the checkout progress bar. One word, lowercase, max about 9 characters.
cart.step.whatsapp: Step name in the checkout progress bar. Keep "whatsapp" lowercase.
cart.stepOf: {n} is the current step, {total} the number of steps.
cart.pieces.one: Plural form for one. A "piece" is one item in the bag.
cart.each: {price} is a formatted price such as €79. Meaning: price per unit.
cart.maxHint: {n} is the largest quantity allowed for one product.
cart.total: Label beside the total. Lowercase, max about 16 characters.
cart.toDetails: Main checkout button (with a WhatsApp icon). Lowercase, max about 24 characters.
cart.field.city: Form label: city and country in one field.
cart.sent.yes: Button: the customer confirms the WhatsApp message was sent, the bag is emptied. Max about 24 characters.
cart.say.qty: Screen-reader announcement. {name} product name, {qty} quantity, {total} formatted price.
checkout.errName: Form error. The limits (2 to 60) are fixed.
checkout.errCity: Form error. The limits (2 to 80) are fixed.
checkout.errNote: Form error. The limit (300) is fixed.
shop.card.add: Tiny button on a product card: add to bag. ONE short word, max 6 characters, lowercase.
shop.card.addLabel: Screen-reader label. {name} is the product name.
shop.card.choose: Small link on a product card. {option} is an option name such as "size" or "volume" (keys option.*). Max about 18 characters in total.
shop.card.look: Small link on a product card that cannot be bought yet. Max about 16 characters.
shop.status.all.one: Count under the filter. Keep {n}. Plural form for one.
shop.status.all.other: Count under the filter. Keep {n}. General plural form.
shop.status.niche.one: {niche} is a category name (niche.wear / niche.scent / niche.tech). Reorder freely.
shop.status.niche.other: {niche} is a category name (niche.wear / niche.scent / niche.tech). Reorder freely.
shop.meta.titleNiche: Browser tab title. {niche} is the category name (its first letter is capitalised automatically). Keep "The Cute Devil".
shop.filter.all: Filter chip: all products. One short word, lowercase.
shop.line.note: Keep the … badge at the place where the word "Sample" belongs and translate the word inside it exactly like common.sample.
shop.band.item1: Scrolling banner item. Lowercase, a few words.
product.backTo: Back link above a product. {niche} is a category name.
product.pick: Form error. {option} is an option name such as "size".
product.add: Main buy button. Lowercase, max about 16 characters.
product.soonBtn: Disabled button text. Max about 34 characters.
product.how1.k: First word of step 1, shown in bold before product.how1.v. Keep the full stop.
product.relatedEyebrow: Small label. {niche} is a category name.
product.lost.title: Headline on the "product not found" page. Keep the <span> tags around the second part.
product.meta.titleName: Browser tab title. {name} is the (untranslated) product name.
option.size: Product option name. One word, lowercase.
option.volume: Product option name for perfumes (30 ml / 50 ml / 100 ml). One word, lowercase.
option.colour: Product option name. One word, lowercase.
option.value.cream: A colour: warm off-white. One word, lowercase.
option.value.navy: A colour: dark blue. One word, lowercase.
prose.updated: Keep the [EFFECTIVE DATE] part unchanged (the owner fills in the date later).
prose.anchor: Screen-reader label of the "#" link beside a heading. {title} is the heading.
prose.englishOnly: Notice on the four legal pages (terms, privacy, cookies, legal notice), whose text stays in English.
home.hero.eyebrow: The three categories, lowercase, separated by " · ". Use the same words as niche.wear, niche.scent, niche.tech.
home.hero.line1:
Giant hero headline, first half of the tagline, lowercase.
forces the line break; the text never wraps by itself. Keep each line under about 11 characters if you can (longer lines are scaled down automatically). You may move or remove the

home.hero.line2: Giant hero headline, second half of the tagline (shown outlined, then in the accent colour). Same rules as home.hero.line1.
home.hero.ring: Text set on a small rotating circle. Lowercase. Keep the four ✦ separators and a similar total length (about 70 characters); it is stretched to fit the circle.

home.band.text1: Word in a big scrolling banner. Lowercase, one or two words. Same idea for every home.band.* key.
home.trio.title: Headline, lowercase. The <span> part is shown in the accent colour.
home.trio.go1: Small link on a category tile. Lowercase, max about 16 characters. Use the category word from niche.wear.
home.mani.text: Manifesto paragraph, revealed word by word. <em> marks the highlighted words: keep some highlights, on the words that carry the same meaning. <span class="u-nowrap"> keeps a highlighted word together with the punctuation after it: keep that pattern or drop the span if your language does not need it.
home.wear.ghost: Huge decorative outline text: the category word (niche.wear) three times, separated by spaces.
home.tech.ghost: Huge decorative outline text: the category word (niche.tech) three times, separated by spaces.
home.wear.eyebrow: Keep the number and the dot separator; translate the category word like niche.wear.
home.scent.ring: Perfume notes set on a rotating circle. Lowercase. Keep the eight ✦ separators and a similar total length (about 70 characters).
home.tech.note1: Tiny callout on an illustration. Lowercase, max about 18 characters.
home.tech.note2: Tiny callout on an illustration. Lowercase, max about 22 characters.
home.how.word1: The headline is four one-word sentences: pick. add. whatsapp. done. Each is one key (word1…word4) and lights up in turn. One short word plus the full stop, lowercase.
home.how.word3: Keep "whatsapp." lowercase with the full stop.
home.close.title: Giant closing headline, lowercase. Max about 18 characters.
story.head.title: Giant headline, lowercase. Max about 20 characters. The <span> part is shown in the accent colour.
story.idea.text: Paragraph revealed word by word. Same rules as home.mani.text for <em> and <span class="u-nowrap">.
story.sides.word1: One giant word with a full stop, lowercase. Same word as in the tagline ("charming").
story.sides.word2: One giant word with a full stop, lowercase. Same word as in the tagline ("mysterious").
story.close.title: Giant closing headline, lowercase. Max about 20 characters.
contact.facts.whatsapp: Label in a small table. Keep "whatsapp" lowercase.
contact.facts.linkedin: Label in a small table. Keep "linkedin" lowercase.
contact.form.button: Submit button, lowercase. Max about 22 characters.
faq.sampleBadge.q: The word in quotation marks is the badge text: translate it exactly like common.sample and use your language's quotation marks.
faq.sampleBadge.a1: Keep the … badge; translate the word inside it exactly like common.sample.
faq.colourTheme.a1: The four theme names (cream, red, purple, blue) are plain colour words: translate them.
faq.stillCurious.a: Keep the links and the phone number. For Arabic, wrap the phone number as +34 622 20 99 35 inside the link so the digits keep their order.

shipping.returns.text1: Keep [WITHDRAWAL PERIOD] unchanged. General information, not legal advice: translate plainly, do not add or remove conditions.
shipping.contact.text: Keep the links and the phone number. For Arabic, wrap the phone number as +34 622 20 99 35.
